name: CSV Viewer
description: Open large CSV and TSV files, then sort, search, filter, inspect columns and export
help: Opens files up to 1 GB. A million rows load in about a second and scroll smoothly, because rows are read from Rust page by page.
Encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16, GBK/GB18030), delimiter and header row are detected automatically; change them in the toolbar if the guess is wrong.
Click a column header to sort. Open a column's details to see statistics and its most frequent values, and to add filters.
Export the current view, sorted and filtered, as CSV, TSV, JSON or a Markdown table. You can also paste a table copied from a spreadsheet.
